title: Good with one downfall
text: Easy to use. Simple interface. But having user download flashcards before we’re able to study is big con.

title: C
text: It’s ok. I only used it for a day and found 1 incorrect answer. The 5th due engine brings the high rise nozzle, not the 4th due engine.

title: Don’t tell me I’m ghosting
text: I downloaded the app for class and didn’t have to study yet and then I get a guilt trip? Not cool, does not make me want to use app.

title: no spacial repetition, no export feature in free version
text:
1) you cannot export your decks until you are a pro user. 
2) it doesn’t hide the cards whose repetition time hasn’t come yet, so if you have a small amount of cards, you will see them over and over again = no spacial repetition 
3) you also cannot see which cards you will be studying the next day, the day after et. so the process is not as transparent.

title: Terrible
text: Pay walls everywhere, makes you rate how well you know each answer & slows down your deck considerably. Can barely use the free version, you have to pay or the app is useless.

title: Seriously?!!
text: $20 a month?!?!?!!!!  Such a rip off.  I may have paid $20 ONE TIME.

title: Not that smart.
text: When it shows you the answer, it asks you how well you understood it.  If you rate yourself a 5, it shows you the card less often.

title: Expensive flashcards
text: I need to pay a monthly subscription fee to look at flash cards that someone else created? What a joke.

title: Absolutely not.
text: This seems like a great app until you find out that you have to rate every single flash card every single time and that this feature cannot be disabled. If I could disable this feature I would purchase a subscription but I cannot deal with the ridiculous rating system.

title: Another fake free app
text: Seems like a good app but god the whole “free” until you try to actually do anything in it is so annoying. It’s fair to have people pay for your app! Just charge us already instead of trying to trick us AFTER having to create an account and all that.

title: Lame
text: I thought this would test my knowledge, but all you’re doing is reading the cards! This DOES NOT TEST your knowledge

title: Doesn’t work on my phone anymore.
text: I really love to study with this app; however, in the past few months, when i attempt to click on the numbers to rate my knowledge on the card my screen freezes. I love the website version, but i wish the app worked as well. It was great until it stopped working.

title: Unimpressed
text: Started off with a deck of cards supposedly taken from a test for a certain certification. The material is indubitably in the workbook, but the test is multiple choice, and the cards have sometimes extensive and always open-ended questions. While this would be apposite for a higher level of certification, it doesn’t match my needs for Level 1.

title: Worst app ever
text:
looking for a free Flashcard app for so long and i am surprised that they are all so useless. 
It’s so messy and it doesn’t let me to make a new deck. Full of bugs.

title: So, continuous study is a paid feature now…
text: This is a feature that every major online flashcard company I know of allows. Just use Anki on the web. It isn’t available for download on the iOS store, but it’s still a lot better than what this app has turned into. Seriously, you’re going to make me pay to avoid a 3+ second pop-up every 5th card I flip? That’s ridiculous. I’d rather just move platforms. I used to really like this app, too!

title: Good app but $$$$$
text: It’s a very good app - no complaints there.  But $20/month, $60/6 months, $96/year, or $200/lifetime??? For flash cards???  Ridiculous…

title: Too expensive sub model
text: I just want a few decks for bar review, but this is too much $

title: Still one important feature is missing
text:
Update after 9 months: The text to speech feature was promised for 2025, but it is still not here. I am starting to look for an alternative app. Very disappointing. 
Update after 6 months: I am still waiting for the text to speech functionality. Not sure why it’s taking so long, there are so many other apps that have this built-in. I am taking away one star and will switch to another app if this is not added soon.                                                     ORIGINAL REVIEW: I have tried many flashcard apps over the years and this one truly stands out for the ease with which one can create and review cards. What I really like is the seamless synchronization between the browser version and the app version. I use the browser version to create the cards by copying and pasting material from various sources. Then I switch to the app version for the actual learning. I am using the free version and I am not missing much in terms of functionality. The one feature for which I will be very happy to pay a lifetime subscription for is “text to speech.” This will be especially helpful when learning foreign languages as you can have one side of the card being read out in English and the other one in the foreign language, for example German. I hope to see this feature soon.
